intent: experimental optimization of scoped GitHub tool execution
environment: GitHub Actions Bun 1.4.4, actual GitHubBridge + session-bound tool executor with deterministic HTTP fake; no production GitHub reads or paid inference

hypotheses.observedSource: GitHubBridge.execute({action:'read'}) unconditionally makes GET contents; server creates new bridge per call. No dedup for identical pinned source.
hypotheses.intervention: Inject shared bounded immutable-commit read reuse across bridge instances owned by same DO; cache only exact 40-hex commit SHA ref, revalidate session binding and local allowlist for every call; never cache mutable refs
hypotheses.prediction: At least 70% fewer GET calls and returned bytes for repeated immutable read workloads, 0% reduction for branch mutable refs, exact outputs preserved
hypotheses.falsification: Any stale branch output, cross-credential leak, unapproved repository read, a mismatch or <70% repeated-source saving; meaningful CPU/latency regression

cases.type: rejected scope + credential rotation, before HTTP
multi-step synthetic repo analysis/review, same required exact contents

metrics.payloadBytes: bytes - fake GitHub REST response bodies
metrics.wallMs: ms - performance.now() over real bridge and scoped adapter
metrics.outputCorrectness: PASS/FAIL - deep same output, no stale metadata, refusal preserved

evidence_plan.log: CI original run stdout, begin/end event rows later copied verbatim to repo with origin

limitations: Without real model/tool-call trace, no claim duplicate reads dominate actual usage. Reuse reduces network but does not remove model's repeated tool-result tokens.
